Bundled player libraries
========================

hls.js 1.6.13 — MIT License
  https://github.com/video-dev/hls.js
  Copyright (c) 2015-2026 video-dev contributors

dash.js 4.7.4 — Apache License 2.0
  https://github.com/Dash-Industry-Forum/dash.js
  Copyright (c) Dash Industry Forum contributors

The minified builds are vendored so mfp.oplay.id remains fully self-contained
and no third-party CDN is contacted by the embedded player.
